module_summary: dash_gfx.c is the dashboard renderer on top of gsKit: theme palette globals, alpha/offset/scissor stacks, gradients, rounded panels built from procedural corner/ring/glow textures, texture-manager bind guards, vsync flip that yields to the file worker, and a sprite batcher used by text and icons. dash_font.c holds the dashboard text system: an EPX-upscaled atlas of the classic 8x16 font, three generated proportional faces (Roboto, Emotion Engine regular/bold), a Shift-JIS to ELISA glyph path for save titles, and measuring/drawing helpers (fit with ellipsis, timed/progress marquee, word wrap, monospace byte glyphs for editors). dash_ftp.c is the modal FTP server status screen. dash_hdd.c is the dashboard HDD Manager: worker jobs for partition scan, PFS usage, create/remove/rename/format/header injection, plus the size picker, partition menu and list/detail drawing.

findings.title: dashTextWrapScrollTimed is never called; the textWrap draw flag exists only for it
findings.problem: dashTextWrapScrollTimed appears only at its definition and its prototype; the linker discards it. Its measurement pass is the only caller of textWrap with draw=0, so once it is gone the draw parameter and the empty if(!draw) branch are dead and textWrap is a private copy of dashTextWrap.
findings.fix: Delete dashTextWrapScrollTimed and its prototype, drop the draw parameter and the if(!draw) branch, and rename textWrap to dashTextWrap (removing the one-line forwarder).
findings.benefit: ~31 lines removed; no ELF change because --gc-sections already drops the 804-byte .text.dashTextWrapScrollTimed (MEASURED: evidence/Launchstation/raw/link/wLaunchELF-gc-discarded-first-party.tsv)
findings.evidence: Grep -w dashTextWrapScrollTimed over src/Launchstation (src, include, tests, scripts, ps2.yaml; docs excluded): dash_font.c:838 (definition) and dash_internal.h:421 (prototype) only. gc-discarded-first-party.tsv lists .text.dashTextWrapScrollTimed 804 bytes from dash_font.o. textWrap callers read: dash_font.c:834 (draw=1), 849 (draw=0), 858 (draw=1).

findings.title: dashGfxShutdown and dashFontShutdown have no callers
findings.problem: Both functions appear only at their definitions and prototypes; the dashboard never shuts down (DashRun does not return) and the linker discards both. The forward declaration of facesShutdown at dash_font.c:307 exists only so dashFontShutdown can call it; facesInit, its other user, is defined after facesShutdown.
findings.fix: Delete dashGfxShutdown, dashFontShutdown, their two prototypes and the facesShutdown forward declaration.
findings.benefit: ~21 lines removed; no ELF change because --gc-sections already drops .text.dashGfxShutdown (180 B) and .text.dashFontShutdown (120 B) (MEASURED: raw/link/wLaunchELF-gc-discarded-first-party.tsv, raw/link-raw/wLaunchELF.gc-sections.log)
findings.evidence: Grep -w dashGfxShutdown|dashFontShutdown over src/Launchstation excluding docs: dash_gfx.c:362, dash_font.c:309, dash_internal.h:334, dash_internal.h:404 only; no tests mention them. gc-sections log: 'removing unused section ...dash_gfx.o:(.text.dashGfxShutdown)' and '...dash_font.o:(.text.dashFontShutdown)'. facesShutdown is defined at dash_font.c:386 and used at 311 and 407.

findings.title: Shift-JIS to ELISA index mapping duplicated between dash_font.c and draw_text.c printXY_sjis
findings.problem: elisaGlyphIndex (comment: 'Same Shift-JIS -> packed ELISA index mapping as the classic renderer') repeats the SJIS->EUC conversion, the font404 gap-table walk and the 6877-glyph bound that printXY_sjis does inline (0x2121+0x8080 == 0xA1A1, 0xFF-0xA1 == 94, n<=55008 bytes == index<ELISA_GLYPHS). About 20 lines are the same logic.
findings.fix: Make elisaGlyphIndex non-static (declare it next to font404) and have printXY_sjis call it, using n = index * 8 and keeping its own '_' fallback for -1.
findings.benefit: ~18 lines removed and one copy of the conversion code (INFERRED: a few hundred bytes of .text)
findings.evidence: Read dash_font.c:46-68 and draw_text.c:261-302; both compiled (ps2.yaml:524 draw_text.c, :581 dash_font.c). Grep 0xA1A1|font404[ over src: only these two sites plus the table at draw_text.c:9. Only difference: elisaGlyphIndex first rejects invalid lead/trail bytes, for which the classic path also ends in '_' or a garbage glyph (INFERRED harmless).

findings.title: Unreachable and duplicate branches in dash_font.c glyph handling
findings.problem: glyphAdv returns the same value for c >= ELISA_CODE and c >= 0x100 in two separate branches. Its c < FONT_FIRST remap and the same remap in drawRun can never fire: both get codes only from nextGlyphs, which already maps c < 0x20 to ' ' (line 361) and otherwise yields '?', 0x100+ pad codes or ELISA codes. The forward declaration of facesInit at line 316 is unused because facesInit is defined at 398 before its first use at 562.
findings.fix: Merge the two glyphAdv branches into one 'c >= 0x100' test, delete the two c < FONT_FIRST remaps and the facesInit forward declaration.
findings.evidence: Read nextGlyphs dash_font.c:328-365 (all outputs), glyphAdv callers 523 and 652 (both fed from nextGlyphs via g[k]), drawRun 574-577. ELISA_CODE is 0x10000 (line 40) so the first glyphAdv branch is a subset of the second. facesInit uses: 316 (decl), 398 (definition), 562, 901.

findings.title: dashSinf/dashCosf are out-of-line forwarders to sinf/cosf
findings.problem: dashSinf and dashCosf only return sinf(x) and cosf(x). Because they are defined in dash_gfx.c, the ~90 call sites in the background, art and UI files pay an extra cross-file call per evaluation in per-frame animation code.
findings.fix: Replace the two prototypes with static inline definitions (or #define to sinf/cosf) in dash_internal.h and delete the two functions from dash_gfx.c; callers stay unchanged.
findings.benefit: ~7 net lines removed; removes one call frame per sin/cos in per-frame background code (INFERRED, not measured)
findings.evidence: Grep -w dashSinf|dashCosf over src/Launchstation: definitions dash_gfx.c:63,68; prototypes dash_internal.h:322-323; callers in dash_bg_ps2.c, dash_bg_geo.c, dash_bg.c, dash_art.c, dash_ui.c. tests/test_orb_seamless.py:38-39 defines its own static stubs, so a header inline needs that test checked.

findings.title: dash_hdd.c: unused hm.scanning field and redundant hm.changed write
findings.problem: The scanning member of the hm state struct is never read or written. In injectMatching, hm.changed = 1 after a successful create is redundant: created is incremented on the line before, and afterChange() at line 927 (run whenever created > 0) sets hm.changed = 1 itself.
findings.fix: Delete the scanning member and the hm.changed = 1 line at 902.
findings.evidence: Grep -w scanning over src/Launchstation: only dash_hdd.c:101 in code (other hits are docs prose). Read injectMatching dash_hdd.c:822-928 and afterChange 596-601.
